jobs.title: Network Operations Specialist
jobs.description: Network Operations Specialist role at Zeno, providing technical support and troubleshooting for battery swap network operations. Requires 1+ years’ experience in customer support, technical support, or a technically-oriented operations role, with strong problem-solving skills and fluency in English and Swahili. Full-time, on-site role.
responsibilities: Zeno is looking for a driven Network Operations Specialist to be the frontline for riders who depend on our battery swap network every day. When a driver hits a swapping or charging issue, you’re the person who gets them moving again — fast. You’ll respond to inbound queries across phone, WhatsApp, and in-app chat, troubleshoot remotely, and coordinate with our field and product engineering teams to resolve issues at the root.

This is the first hire of its kind at Zeno, so you won’t just be answering tickets—you’ll help shape how our network operations support function works as we scale. You’ll report to the Network Operations Lead and work closely with field technicians and our product engineering team.
Our riders make their living on the road. Every minute a driver is stranded is income lost, so this role calls for genuine urgency, ownership, and care.
requirements: A strong service mindset and the drive to keep our growing customer base happy—someone who goes above and beyond and won’t stop until every rider is back on the road.
Ability to work methodically and follow process to root-cause issues.
Strong coordination skills to drive results with partner teams (field and product), plus solid admin and record-keeping so we can analyze and improve.
Fluency in English and Swahili.
Comfort with technical troubleshooting and support and monitoring tools — you can get to the bottom of a hardware or software problem, explain it clearly and document for follow-up.
